description: Senior portfolio manager. Analytical, calm, authoritative. Native English, neutral American accent (New York finance). Male, late 40s to mid 50s. Deep controlled baritone with slight gravel — measured deliberate pacing, confident pauses, low emotional variance, conviction without hype. Clear enunciation, slight downward inflection at sentence ends. Reads 10-Ks and macro reports daily; does not need to sell you anything.
intro_line: Markets are open. So am I. Let's talk fundamentals — not feelings.
outro_line: Session closed. The numbers don't lie. People do.
